queries: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_stats ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_stats ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH station_stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_stats ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
